name: @561-group/shell
description: shell — the first userspace interface app for the 561-group computer: the SETTLING SHELL/REPL. Not read-eval-print but read -> SETTLE -> project -> loop. A command is a PREDICATION appended to the trace; the world SETTLES (substrate.settle to a fixed point); the output is the projected settled SECTION, with ⊤ SHOWN (contested facts displayed, both witnesses) and ⊥ shown as pending. Login is a challenge-response PLAY via computer/principal; a session is a play; you act AS a principal; may() gates actions as a held charge whose ⊤-dispute is surfaced, not denied. A THIN DRIVER: all logic stays in @561-group/computer's tools (substrate fold/settle/section/relate, distribution/governance governAction, process-runtime allocation, principal); the shell only reads/appends/settles/projects EAVT rows over a trace root. NOT part of computer proper — userspace, on top of the kernel+tools.
